messages:
leo: Heads-up: saw a small throughput dip on route X after the scoped-role preview went live for a few tenants. Could be RBAC eval hitting the critical path.

anya: Same incident, looks like the policy-evaluator fell back to DB lookups on cache miss. Latency spike ~70ms on the call path.

sam: Are we sure its evaluator and not telemetry enrichment? Two separate PRs merged around the same time.

talia: I can confirm the consoles Access Insights panel was toggled on for one tenant during the window. That panel requests per-request role context for historical charts.

maria: That explains it. We added a synchronous enrichment call in the telemetry path when role context is requested by the UI. Bad place for sync IO.

leo: Options: 1) move enrichment off-path (async join later), 2) add node-local TTL cache for role evals, 3) add sampled enrichment so only a subset pay the extra cost. Thoughts?

anya: Prefer local TTL cache + event invalidation. Keeps per-request cost low and consistent. We'll accept eventual consistency during fast rollouts.

sam: For analytics queries we still need historical joins. Suggest a derived mapping table (minute-bucket principal->role_hash) produced in pipeline so queries don't hit primary DB.

talia: UX: add an "Access Insights" toggle on dashboards to enable role-context joins. Default OFF. When ON, show a one-line warning: "Historical role joins may increase query cost; estimated time: ~xxs" and require confirmation.

maria: Backend API sketch for the query service:
```
GET /insights/query?metric=route_latency&group_by=route,role_hash&window=1h&sample=0.001&as_of=2026-03-10T14:00:00Z
```
We will honor `sample` to avoid cardinality spikes.

leo: Telemetry naming: prefer dotted metric names `policy.eval.latency`, `policy.eval.cache_hit`. Let's avoid embedding role metadata in metric names. Emit `role_hash` as tag.

anya: Security note: role_hash only. No full role JSON in telemetry. Also mask tenant ids in public dashboards.

sam: UI cost estimation idea: before running a grouped query, the console calls a cheap estimator endpoint that returns estimated rows and estimated time. API: `POST /insights/estimate` with `group_by` and `time_range`.

maria: We'll implement estimator using historical sampling stats stored in the derived table. It can return confidence bands.

ops-bot: alert: policy-evaluator latency above 50ms observed on 2 prod nodes in eu-west for 5m.

leo: Ok let's do rollout plan: feature-flag local cache + estimator -> enable for 5 canary orgs -> enable Access Insights UI for the same orgs -> monitor `policy.eval.latency` and query cost metrics -> expand. Rollback knob: disable sampling + UI toggle.

talia: UX copy for the warning: "Grouping by role increases query complexity and may incur additional cost. Use a narrow time window or sampling for exploratory queries."

sam: I'll open the PRs for header flag `X-Role-Trace: true` and the sampling param on the query API. Will include docs and a small migration note for saved dashboards. ETA EOD.

maria: I'll wire up the derived mapping pipeline and estimator. Will include telemetry tags for cache_hit, sample_rate.

leo: Thanks. Please @me on PRs; I'll run the canary dashboard checks.
